dataBoundary: Original six-item simulation: 221 complete records from lecture 6. Independent ordinal confirmation sample: 400 newly simulated rows. Added S1-S3 items are a nine-item SEM extension. No real survey or validated instrument is claimed.

sources.title: Revelle, psych: Exploratory Factor analysis using MinRes
sources.use: Lecture 8: common/unique variance, MINRES, rotations, pattern/structure matrices, factor-score uncertainty; computed outputs use pinned package versions.

sources.title: Revelle, psych: Parallel Analysis Scree Plots
sources.use: Lecture 8: common-factor versus component retention and random-reference reasoning. Actual example uses an explicitly documented ordinal-permutation, SMC-diagonal implementation, not an undocumented default fa.parallel result.

sources.title: psych: Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin Measure of Sampling Adequacy
sources.use: Lecture 8: Pearson KMO/MSA diagnostic; not a model-fit, validity or factor-count test.

sources.title: MacCallum, Widaman, Zhang, Hong (1999), Sample size in factor analysis
sources.use: Author-hosted research paper: sample planning depends on communalities and factor overdetermination, not a universal subject-to-item ratio.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: ESEM and EFA
sources.use: Lecture 8: exploratory structure versus a priori confirmatory structure; measurement and structural parts.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: A CFA example
sources.use: Lecture 9: specified measurement restrictions, factor scaling, output interpretation. No Holzinger-Swineford empirical results are relabeled as service data.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: Categorical data
sources.use: Lecture 9: ordered response thresholds, DWLS estimation with WLSMV corrections, incompatibility of this route with continuous-ML FIML.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: Estimators and more
sources.use: Lecture 9: estimator/SE/test-statistic distinctions, missing-data conditions, avoid ordinary subtraction of scaled chi-square values.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: Modification indices
sources.use: Lecture 9: MI and EPC diagnostic meaning; no model is automatically modified in this example.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: Mediation
sources.use: Lecture 9: labeled path products, totals and delta-method uncertainty. Actual coefficients and intervals are reproduced from the archived simulation.

sources.title: lavaan official tutorial: Multiple groups
sources.use: Lecture 9: conceptual introduction to measurement comparability; no empirical group-invariance analysis is claimed.

sources.title: Wu and Estabrook (2016), Identification of CFA models for ordered categorical outcomes
sources.use: Lecture 9: ordered-response thresholds, identification, and parameterization-dependent invariance constraints.

sources.title: Maxwell and Cole (2007), Bias in cross-sectional analyses of longitudinal mediation
sources.use: Lecture 9: cross-sectional path products do not establish temporal mediation or causal identification.

sources.title: International Test Commission, Guidelines for Translating and Adapting Tests, second edition
sources.use: Lectures 8-9: adoption, adaptation, permissions, understanding and equivalence evidence. No copyrighted scale items are reproduced.

sources.title: AERA, APA, NCME: Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing
sources.use: Lecture 9: evidence for intended score interpretations and uses; internal structure is one part of the validity argument.

sources.title: Messick (1993), Foundations of Validity: Meaning and Consequences in Psychological Assessment
sources.use: Lecture 9: construct interpretation, content and use boundaries; no fit threshold is treated as a validity certificate.
